verdict.rationale: GitLab positions CI/CD as a core part of its platform for building and shipping software, with workflows customizable for deployment ([gitlab-docs-19], [gitlab-docs-18]). Its docs describe connecting Kubernetes clusters to deploy and manage applications ([gitlab-docs-46]), and partners such as Pulumi offer push-to-deploy through GitLab CI ([gitlab-intdir-8]). A community report of teams being unable to deploy when CI workers didn't run ([gitlab-comm-1]) is an availability complaint, not a counter-example to the capability, and indirectly confirms deployments run through GitLab CI. missing for 10: first-party docs detailing deploy job configuration, environments, or release/rollback mechanics, and independent hands-on confirmation of a deployment workflow.
